messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Elevated token latency detected for /v1/generate (hosted, us-east-1). 95th pctl ~8.2s, baseline ~2.1s. Error rate 0.4%. Trigger: latency-policy-95-us-east. Graph: https://monitoring.redwood/graph?panel=latency_us_east
Alex G: I'm oncall, confirming pager. Jumping into war room: https://meet.redwood/warroom/IR-1893 :wave:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-4382 acknowledged by Alex G :white_check_mark:
Maria T: tagging runtime + infra. initial impact assessment: increased latency for hosted generate endpoint in us-east-1. No widespread 5xx spike, some client retries observed. Potential performance regression after autoscaler adjustments earlier today.
Samir P: taking ownership for mitigation. first steps: check cache miss rate and node churn. Running quick queries against runtime metrics.
Samir P: logs show large KV cache eviction volume around 2026-03-15T20:01Z. eviction_rate went from 5/s -> 180/s. autoscaler fired and added 8 nodes; that created cache cold starts.
Tara SRE: confirmed. also seeing backlog in prefill pipeline, latency correlates with node join events.
Alex G: immediate mitigation plan?
Samir P: propose temporary autoscaler pause + scale down to stable capacity, and run cache warmup job to re-populate KV cache for hot prefixes. If that doesn't help, fail traffic to fallback model-variant with smaller memory footprint.
Jen L: I can do the autoscaler pause + warmup. handing to me for the next 30m. Handoff noted — I will update ops runbook when complete.
IR Manager: keep status page draft and external comms ready. If >10% of requests affected or any customer alerts, escalate to exec comms.
Alex G: draft status page (please review):
```
Status: Investigating
Components: Hosted API (us-east-1)
Impact: Some customers may experience elevated latency for text generation (percent of affected requests small but user-visible). No data loss reported.
Workaround: Retry with backoff; we are rolling a mitigation now.
Updates: We will post updates every 15 minutes or on milestone changes.
```
Maria T: suggested external message for CS/Support to send to customers: "We're investigating increased latency for the hosted inference endpoint in us-east-1. Our engineers are actively mitigating; we'll update you within 30 minutes. Contact support if you see errors beyond retries." Keep it short.
Alex G: internal comms template for channels and sales: "Incident IR-1893: Elevated latency in us-east-1 affecting some hosted API requests. Mitigation: pausing autoscaler and warming KV cache. ETA for next update: ~15 min."
Samir P: commands I'm going to run (run as op-admin):
```
# pause horizontal autoscaler
kubectl annotate hpa runtime-autoscaler freeze=true --overwrite
# lock desired capacity to 12
kubectl patch hpa runtime-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":12,"maxReplicas":12}}'
# run cache warmup job for hot prefixes
kubectl apply -f jobs/cache-warmup-us-east.yaml
```
Samir P: running commands now, will stream logs here.
oncall-bot: runbook link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-warmup (owner: runtime-team)
Samir P: cache-warmup job started. initial logs:
```
[2026-03-15T20:05:12Z] warmup: prefix=system_prompts, hits=0 -> warming
[2026-03-15T20:06:04Z] warmup: prefix=system_prompts, hits=1200
```
Tara SRE: I'm watching the ingestion queue. backlog dropped from 1800 -> 220 within 6 minutes. 95th pctl latency in us-east down to ~3.4s (was 8.2s).
Alex G: good progress. Agree to hold onfalling back to smaller model for now. Keep autoscaler frozen until warmup completes and we see steady p95 < 2.5s for 5m.
Jen L: paused autoscaler and locked replicas to 12. Applied warmup. Rolling restart deferred.
Maria T: draft customer-facing status page update (short):
"We are investigating an issue causing increased latency for generation requests in our us-east-1 region. We have paused autoscaling and are warming caches to restore normal performance. No data loss is expected. We will provide another update in 15 minutes."
IR Manager: approved. Post to status page after Samir confirms improved p95.
statusbot: Status page update queued for posting after approval by Alex G.
Samir P: p95 tracking: 20:12Z -> 3.1s, 20:18Z -> 2.3s. Error rate stable.
Alex G: post status now and notify support + sales slack channel with approved text.
incident-bot: Incident created IR-1893 (severity: S2). War room link: https://meet.redwood/warroom/IR-1893
Jen L: I'll take next 30m of mitigation ops. Alex, Samir — if anything regresses please @pagerduty.
Alex G: handoff to Jen L at 20:20Z. I will be reachable. After-action: collect timeline, commit autoscaler config change, and run reproducible replay to verify warmup effect.
Tara SRE: notes for postmortem: root-cause hypothesis: autoscaler churn causing cold starts and KV cache eviction due to lowered node memory thresholds. Next steps: add guard to prevent concurrent heavy autoscale events and add cache-prefill during scale-up.
IR Manager: good. Please capture customer list and any rate-limited accounts for direct outreach.
Samir P: marking mitigation successful for now. Leaving warmup running for 30 more minutes then will re-enable autoscaler with higher minReplicas.
Alex G: thanks team. :thumbsup: Closing immediate paging loop; keeping incident open for postmortem and follow-up actions.
